notes.title: Early Access Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Please let us know if  any of these changes significantly improve or diminish your play experience. You are the vanguard of awesomeness. Thanks!

[olist]
Puzzles: Unlocked puzzle 13.
Surfing: Introduced variable speed surfing: click the touchpad to surf; move the thumb up to go fast, down to go slow. Double-click to surf disabled.
Surfing: Removed slight “jump” when surfing starts.
Dying: Increased temporary invulnerability after being hit from 1 to 2 seconds.
VFX: Added a bit of smoke and sparks to disabled turrets.
Model: Adjusted Kitty’s head position to prevent visual artifacts when she blinks. 
In-Game Menu: Decreased chance of menu items getting caught in the blur effect.
Loading: Disabled the resolution dialogue box that opens when starting the game so it can be seamlessly launched from VR. 
[/olist]
